capabilities: Synchronize notes, attachments, and Trash folder with a Dropbox App Folder
Preview proposed sync operations before applying them
Save concurrent edits as conflict copies in Sync Conflicts/
Record deletion tombstones so stale devices cannot restore deleted notes
Connect devices via OAuth using a shared App Key and Vault ID
extras: Early test release (v0.2.3) with manual installation by copying files into the plugins folder; sync is manual-only, files are limited to 100 MiB, and the README urges keeping backups and testing on a vault copy before migrating from Remotely Save.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a whole vault via Dropbox while safely handling concurrent edits and deletions across devices.

relations.evidence: Do not run Remotely Save and Synced Vault simultaneously on a live vault.

requires.name: Dropbox App Key from a user-created scoped app

summary: Dropbox-based vault sync plugin that previews changes before applying them, keeps conflict copies, and records deletion tombstones.
